propositions: Comment identity must shift from body-equality deduplication to a persistent HLC-timestamp-to-Jira-comment-ID map to prevent collisions on same-text comments and to enforce append-only semantics without edits/deletes.

The returned Jira comment ID from add_comment must be captured at both enactment sites (create_one and update_one via handle_update/_apply_outbound_update) and persisted in binding_store with write-ahead durability against the local_comment_key.

Outbound skip logic must check the persistent map and inbound jira_comment_id as primary identity guards, demoting normalized-body equality to a secondary fallback, while inbound differ remains unchanged and authoritative only for jira_comment_id.

Comment bodies must render through RichTextCodec.to_wire (AdfCodec for Cloud, WikiTextCodec for DC) with fit-then-serialize ordering, and the a32a _resolve_codec injection must migrate from _IdentityCodec to the real codec for dedup-key convergence.
Append-only semantics must be enforced bidirectionally: new comments mirror once, edits and deletes are skipped, and a mapped key/ID is never re-synced.
The comment-ID map must be change-gated with no per-pass churn, and crash-durability must be ensured by immediate save() of record_comment_id on successful add_comment return.
